name: CodeArena
description: CodeArena is an online evaluation platform for large language model code generation that features a collective evaluation mechanism to dynamically recalibrate model scores and mitigate benchmark leakage biases. It provides open access to submitted solutions and test cases along with automation-friendly APIs for streamlined code evaluation.
reputation: An emerging code-generation evaluation platform designed to reduce leakage bias and provide more dynamic, community-oriented scoring.
notes: Addresses benchmark leakage and data dissipation; provides public repository and APIs for evaluation.
